about_the_game:
The legends of the Norse gods are more than just myths—they are warnings, prophecies, and forgotten truths waiting to be uncovered. In this exciting DLC to the "Mystery of Myths: Mystery of the Fjords", take on the role of Elijah Reed, a top agent of the Ministry of Mysteries, as he embarks on a perilous mission deep in the heart of Norwegian folklore. Ancient relics, lost knowledge, and mystical creatures stand between you and the ultimate goal: preventing Ragnarok, the apocalyptic end of the world.

With four brand-new locations, more hidden object challenges, intricate mini-games, and mind-bending puzzles, this DLC offers an even richer, more immersive experience. Journey through the mythical realms of Yggdrasil, meet legendary figures, and unlock the mysteries buried in Viking lore. But beware—your choices will shape the fate of the gods and the world as you know it!

🗝️ DISCUSS MYTHOLOGY WITH FREYA!

Freya, the goddess of wisdom and war, holds the key to unraveling ancient prophecies, but first, you must find the Almanac of the Gods—a sacred text hidden in the museum library. Solve intricate mini-games and hidden object puzzles to access its long-lost knowledge!

🗝️ EXPLORE LOKI’S TEMPLE!

Venture into the ruins of Loki’s temple, a place of deception and forgotten magic. Navigate through illusions, solve a musical puzzle, and unlock an ancient chest containing a powerful artifact. But beware—Loki’s spirit lingers, ready to test your wits!

🗝️ LEARN THE HISTORY OF THE HACHI STONE!

In a secret throne room, an ancient relic holds the memories of the past. Search for hidden objects, reconstruct fragments of history, and use the Well of Old Times to reveal the truth behind the Hachi Stone, a key to understanding the gods' fate!

🗝️ FIND OUT HOW TO STOP RAGNAROK!

Time is running out! Deep in the Hall of Tales, an ancient mythical tome holds the last clues to preventing Ragnarok. Recover its scattered pages, decipher runes and puzzles, and rewrite history before it's too late!

Dare to enter the world of gods, magic, and destiny? Your greatest adventure begins now!
